request_mail.subject: Pipe is leaking
request_mail.body:
Hello,

the pipe under my bathroom sink is dripping. I put a towel under it. Then a second towel. I am running out of towels.

Could you send someone? :availability

Thank you,
:customer

availability_notes.morning: I am only home in the mornings.
availability_notes.afternoon: I am only home in the afternoons, I work mornings.
availability_notes.any: I am home all day, so any time works.

availability.missed: The technician rang the bell at :customer's place. Nobody was home. They told us when they are home. In writing.

skill.met: Right technician for a pipe, too.
skill.missed: You sent a heating specialist to a leaking pipe. He looked at it with great respect and called a plumber. Two trips.

urgency.met: And quick. The towels thank you.
urgency.missed: A dripping pipe does not wait that long. By then :customer will need a boat.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey champ,

about the leak at :customer's.
feedback_mail.outro:
Keep it up. Or at least keep it level.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: :customer?
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

:customer is still waiting for someone to look at that pipe. Appointment, confirmation mail, calendar. The usual.

Gary

request_mail.subject: Radiator stays cold
request_mail.body:
Hello,

my living room radiator stays cold no matter what I do. I turned the knob. I talked to it. Nothing.

Can someone have a look? :availability

Best,
:customer

availability_notes.morning: Mornings are best, I am out in the afternoons.
availability_notes.afternoon: Please come in the afternoon, I am at work in the mornings.

availability.met: :customer was home and had coffee ready. For the technician. Not for us.
availability.missed: Nobody was home at :customer's. The technician wrote a note. The note was also cold.

skill.met: Good call sending a heating specialist.
skill.missed: You sent a plumber to a radiator. He bled it, shrugged, and billed us for the shrug.

urgency.met: And soon enough that nobody had to wear a scarf indoors.
urgency.missed: It took so long that :customer bought a space heater. From a competitor.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey,

quick one about the radiator at :customer's.
feedback_mail.outro:
My door is always open. Still the hinge.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: Radiator at :customer's
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

:customer called again about the cold radiator. Please get someone out there and let them know when.

Gary

request_mail.subject: EMERGENCY: burst pipe
request_mail.body:
Hello?!

a pipe in my basement just burst. There is a fountain now. I did not order a fountain.

I turned off something that looked like the main valve. It might have been the washing machine. Please send someone as fast as humanly possible. :availability

:customer

availability_notes.morning: I have to leave for work at noon, water or no water, so mornings only.
availability_notes.afternoon: I am stuck at work until lunch, so afternoons please.
availability_notes.any: I am not going anywhere. I am guarding the fountain.

availability.met: :customer opened the door in rubber boots. Right on time.
availability.missed: Nobody opened the door at :customer's. The technician could hear the water, though.

skill.met: And a plumber for a burst pipe. Textbook.
skill.missed: You sent a heating specialist to a flooded basement. He said it was not his department and left dry.

urgency.met: Next day. The basement is a basement again.
urgency.missed: By the time we showed up, :customer was renting the basement out as an indoor pool.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer (emergency)
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey,

about the burst pipe at :customer's. Emergencies are where we earn our reputation. Or lose it.
feedback_mail.outro:
Emergencies do not wait. Neither does my blood pressure.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: :customer - still flooding?
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

:customer still has water where water should not be. This is the emergency desk. Emergency means now, not eventually.

Gary

missing_mail.subject: :customer: valve missing
missing_mail.body:
Hey,

the technician made it to :customer. The valve did not. The part never reached us in time.

Book a new appointment once the part is here. And tell :customer before the water does.

Gary

request_mail.subject: Heating is dead, it is freezing
request_mail.body:
Hello,

our boiler made a sound like a sad trombone and stopped. The house is at 54 degrees and dropping. The cat has moved into the oven drawer. The oven is off, do not worry.

Please send someone urgently. :availability

:customer

availability_notes.morning: Someone is home in the mornings.
availability_notes.afternoon: We are only home in the afternoons.
availability_notes.any: We are home all day. Wearing all our coats.

availability.met: :customer let the technician in and offered him a blanket.
availability.missed: Nobody was home at :customer's. Probably went somewhere warm.

skill.met: A heating specialist for a dead boiler. Good.
skill.missed: You sent a plumber to a dead boiler. He tightened a pipe for moral support.

urgency.met: Warm again by the next day. The cat has left the oven drawer.
urgency.missed: It took so long that :customer's family now speaks fluent shivering.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer (emergency)
feedback_mail.outro:
Warm houses, happy customers. Cold houses, angry reviews.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: :customer is freezing
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

:customer is still sitting in a cold house. Emergency desk, remember? Book someone.

Gary

missing_mail.subject: :customer: burner missing
missing_mail.body:
Hey,

the technician stood in the boiler room at :customer. Without a burner. It did not arrive in time.

Book a new appointment once the part is here. :customer keeps freezing until then. :customer will remember that.

Gary

request_mail.subject: Annual boiler service
request_mail.body:
Dear Flowright team,

per our service contract, our boiler is due for its annual check. It works fine. It has always worked fine. I would like to keep it that way, contractually.

:availability

Kind regards,
:customer

availability_notes.afternoon: Please schedule it for an afternoon.
availability_notes.any: Any time within the next week is fine.

availability.met: The service visit fit :customer's schedule perfectly. Contract customers notice that.
availability.missed: Nobody was home at :customer's for the service visit. Contract customers renew contracts. Or they do not.

skill.met: A heating specialist for a boiler service, as the contract says.
skill.missed: You sent a plumber to service a boiler. He read the manual out loud. The customer was not impressed.

urgency.met: And within the service window. Clean paperwork.
urgency.missed: We missed the service window. Legal wants a word. Legal always wants a word.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer (service contract)
feedback_mail.intro:
Hi,

about the service visit at :customer's.
feedback_mail.outro:
Contracts are recurring revenue. Recurring revenue is my favorite kind of revenue.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: Service visit at :customer's
reminder_mail.body:
Hi,

the annual service at :customer's is still not scheduled. They pay us every year to remember this. Please remember this.

Gary

request_mail.subject: Scheduled drain inspection
request_mail.body:
Hello,

our contract includes a yearly drain inspection. Nothing is blocked. My brother-in-law says that is exactly when you should check. He says a lot of things.

:availability

Best regards,
:customer

availability.met: :customer was home and had cleared a path to the basement. Very professional.
availability.missed: The technician stood in front of a locked door at :customer's. The drains remain uninspected. And offended.

skill.met: A plumber for the drains. As it should be.
skill.missed: You sent a heating specialist to inspect drains. He inspected the radiator instead. Out of habit.

urgency.missed: Outside the contract window. The brother-in-law will hear about this.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer (service contract)
feedback_mail.intro:
Hi,

quick note on the drain inspection at :customer's.

reminder_mail.subject: Drain inspection for :customer
reminder_mail.body:
Hi,

the drain inspection for :customer is still open. The contract says yearly. Not whenever.

Gary

request_mail.subject: Blocked toilet
request_mail.body:
Hello,

our toilet is blocked. We tried a plunger, then two plungers at the same time. That did not help, but it looked determined.

Can you send somebody? :availability

Kind regards,
:customer

availability_notes.morning: I am only home in the mornings.
availability_notes.afternoon: Afternoons I am home, mornings I am not.
availability_notes.any: I am home all day. We are using the downstairs toilet in the meantime.

availability.met: :customer opened the door, the time was right.
availability.missed: Nobody home at :customer. The technician rang and waited. So did the toilet.

skill.met: And the right technician for it.
skill.missed: A heating specialist in front of a blocked toilet is a sad picture. Two trips.

urgency.met: Done quickly. A family without a toilet gets impolite fast.
urgency.missed: It took a while. :customer got to know the neighbours in the meantime. Thoroughly.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer
feedback_mail.outro:
Not pretty, but it is our business. Figuratively.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: :customer is waiting
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

:customer still has a blocked toilet. Appointment, confirmation, calendar.

Gary

request_mail.subject: The pipes are knocking
request_mail.body:
Hello,

for a week the pipes have been knocking at night. First we blamed ghosts, then the neighbours, now the plumbing.

Please send somebody who will listen to it. :availability

Regards,
:customer

availability_notes.morning: Mornings I am home, although it never knocks then.
availability_notes.any: I always have time, and the knocking has no schedule either.

availability.met: :customer was there and even offered coffee.
availability.missed: Nobody home at :customer. The knocking was there, but it does not sign anything.

skill.met: The right person for knocking pipes.
skill.missed: The colleague was scheduled for heating. He listened politely and did nothing.

urgency.met: Handled quickly. :customer sleeps through the night again.
urgency.missed: It took a while. :customer has given the knocking a name by now.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey,

about the knocking pipes at :customer.
feedback_mail.outro:
Not an emergency, but customers remember nights.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: :customer, still knocking?
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

the knocking pipes at :customer are still open.

Gary

request_mail.subject: EMERGENCY: backflow in the basement
request_mail.body:
Hello,

there is water in the basement and it is not coming from above. I will not describe this any further.

Please send somebody now. :availability

:customer

availability_notes.morning: I am home in the morning, then I have to leave.
availability_notes.afternoon: I work in the morning, afternoons I am home.
availability_notes.any: I am not going anywhere. I am just not going into the basement.

availability.met: :customer had already propped the basement door open.
availability.missed: Nobody home at :customer. The basement opened up on its own, so to speak.

skill.met: The right technician for the backflow valve.
skill.missed: A heating specialist in a sewage basement. He came back up quickly.

urgency.met: Done the next day. The basement is a basement again.
urgency.missed: Too late. The basement is now a topic for the whole street.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer (emergency)
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey,

about the backflow at :customer. Emergencies are our reputation.
feedback_mail.outro:
Emergencies do not wait. Neither does my blood pressure.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: :customer - still in the basement?
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

:customer still has water in the basement. This is the emergency desk, not maintenance.

Gary

missing_mail.subject: :customer: valve missing
missing_mail.body:
Hey,

the technician stood in the basement at :customer. Without the valve. The part did not arrive in time.

Book a new appointment once it is here. And call :customer before the basement does.

Gary

request_mail.subject: EMERGENCY: no hot water
request_mail.body:
Hello,

since this morning only cold water comes out. I pressed everything that looked like a button.

Please send somebody. :availability

:customer

availability_notes.morning: I am home in the morning.
availability_notes.afternoon: Afternoons I am home, mornings at the office.
availability_notes.any: I am here. I cannot shower cold at any time of day.

availability.met: :customer was there and had already unlocked the boiler room.
availability.missed: Nobody home at :customer. The water stayed cold.

skill.met: And a heating specialist for the heating. Logical, but not a given.
skill.missed: You sent a plumber to the boiler. He looked at it like a stranger's car.

urgency.met: Warm again the next day. Textbook.
urgency.missed: It took a while. :customer showered at the neighbours in the meantime. Repeatedly.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer (emergency)
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey,

about the hot water at :customer.
feedback_mail.outro:
Cold water wakes customers up. Unfortunately it also makes them angry.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: :customer is showering cold
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

:customer still has no hot water. Please take care of it.

Gary

request_mail.subject: Bleed the radiators
request_mail.body:
Hello,

the radiators gurgle and stay cold at the top. The neighbours say you have to let the air out. I do not have the key for that and no desire to find one.

An appointment, please. :availability

Kind regards,
:customer

availability_notes.any: I am flexible, so are the radiators.

availability.met: :customer was there and every radiator was reachable.
availability.missed: Nobody home at :customer. The radiators keep gurgling.

skill.missed: A plumber with a bleed key is better than nothing, but not by much.

urgency.met: Done within the week. That is planning.
urgency.missed: That took too long for a job that needs twenty minutes.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey,

about bleeding the radiators at :customer.
feedback_mail.outro:
Maintenance is boring. Boring is good for business.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: :customer still gurgling
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

the radiator job at :customer is still open.

Gary

request_mail.subject: Replace the water meter
request_mail.body:
Hello,

according to the utility my water meter has been due since 1992. I am attaching the notice in case you want to see it. I have been seeing it for weeks.

An appointment, please. :availability

:customer

availability_notes.any: Reachable all day, and so is the meter.

availability.met: :customer was there and had already cleared the meter cabinet.
availability.missed: Nobody home at :customer. The meter keeps counting anyway.

skill.met: A plumber for the meter. Exactly right.
skill.missed: The heating technician found the meter but did not replace it. Another trip.

urgency.met: Done in time, the utility is happy.
urgency.missed: Too late. The utility now writes to us instead of :customer.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :customer
feedback_mail.outro:
Paperwork with water attached. Still has to happen.

Gary

reminder_mail.subject: :customer, the meter?
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

the meter replacement at :customer is still open. The utility is patient, but not forever.

Gary

missing_mail.subject: :customer: meter missing
missing_mail.body:
Hey,

the technician made it to :customer, the new meter did not. The part never arrived in time.

Book a new appointment once it is here.

Gary
